messages:
Ava (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands. i'll hang here for 20 mins to take short, focused q's about mission, market positioning, and the roadmap. keep it punchy. :wave:
Jordan (Eng): are we committing to explicit SLA tiers for Hosted vs Dedicated?
Ava (CEO): yes — Hosted will have a baseline SLA for paid plans; Dedicated gets higher SLOs and an enterprise SLA option. we'll publish the tiers in the docs next week.
Pri (Sales): short line for exec decks vs model vendors? need something non-technical.
Maya (Head of Strategy): try: "Redwood Inference removes the operational burden of running LLMs in production — predictable performance, measurable unit economics, and enterprise controls across any infrastructure."
Chris (VP Product): follow-up: should we be pushing Optimize (cost/perf toolkit) in sales demos now or wait for more automation?
Maya (Head of Strategy): push it now as a consultative feature: recommendations + quant profiles. flag automation as "coming soon" so customers know it's on the roadmap.
Jordan (Eng): competitor question: how public should perf claims be? customers want numbers.
Ava (CEO): be transparent but conservative: publish curated benchmarks (models + sequences) and methodology. avoid sweeping comparisons in public collateral; sales can share detailed battlecards.
Pri (Sales): objection prep: "Why pay Redwood when we can stitch open-source + infra?" one-liner?
Chris (VP Product): short: "Maybe you can, but building, tuning, and operating to meet SLAs and rollouts is non-trivial — we productize that work so your team ships features not infra."
Jordan (Eng): any change to Private deployment timeline? we have a prospective pilot asking.
Ava (CEO): no change: pilot slots open in Q3, GA targeted in Q4. top engineering priorities: KMS/HSM integrations, audit logs, and on-prem upgrade tooling.
Maya (Head of Strategy): for GTM: let's emphasize three measurable outcomes in collateral — reduced p99 latency, % requests served from cache, and estimated unit cost savings. numbers sell.
NotesBot: all-hands follow-up posted to docs at 1766254400 by NotesBot
Pri (Sales): can you drop the short mission copy into the marketing channel? i'll grab it for decks.
Ava (CEO): will do. thanks all 10. if you want deeper competitive briefings, book time with Maya/Chris.
